title: The 1973 “Morris Worm” That Started Modern Cybersecurity

scenes.text: In 1973 a tiny worm spread across 6 U.S. universities in minutes
Created by Robert Tappan Morris, it exploited a buffer overflow in the UNIX 'rsh' service
The worm unintentionally slowed down networks, prompting the first coordinated incident response effort
It forced the creation of the first Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT) at Carnegie Mellon University
